title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms — Episode7 Seeing Them Blossom With You

meta.Episode: Episode7 — Seeing Them Blossom With You
meta.Event Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, cherry blossoms...!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I saw them on my way home after I did a street performance and thought that I should show you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Thank you very much. They might even be the most beautiful cherry blossoms I've ever seen.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because we're seeing them together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Together? Us?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
When you see things with someone you care about, it becomes more special, more beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That includes cherry blossoms, stars and even classrooms... You end up creating precious memories with the people that mean the most to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're one of those people, Miku. It has to be why these cherry blossoms look so beautiful now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The last time I was here, I sang one of your songs and felt like I needed to see you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's just... So much has happened since we first met...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. You're right.
So much has changed since then too.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. I never would've dreamed of the four of us playing in a band together like this back then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't even think that we'd be able to be friends again to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you helped us reconnect with each other. We couldn't have come this far without you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I asked you to come here today to play a song for you that says just that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, I'm a little embarassed to play your own song in front of you but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Don't worry.
Please, let me hear your song.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Her voice is so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ever since I met Ichika, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She looked so sad the first time I saw her.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She wanted to be friends with the others again so bad, but didn't know how...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But when the four of them played together in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They were sort of all over the place back then...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But their music made them realize just how much they all mean to each other. They realized that they all wanted the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They argued and fought a little after that too, but it didn't end there...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichika and I started a band!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It all started with Ichika and Saki.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ichika's expression slowly started to change after that every time I saw her in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What started as I can't turned into I'll try. She looked so determined.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The next time I saw her in SEKAI after that...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miku! Luka! Sorry for barging in! We have to master this song so that Shiho will join our band!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry if we're asking too much, but this is our chance to have Shiho join! Could you please help us practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They were so adamant about practicing as hard as they could to convince Shiho into joining their band.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Luckily, they managed to reach her and became a happy group of four.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And then...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're all amazing, and very dear to me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's why I want us all to be in this band together. Maybe there's something else that could bring us back together, but this is what I want.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ichika managed to find her true feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And after Ichika told Honami how she really felt, their song was born.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There were times when they strayed from their path and each other, but they finally got their band back together.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And Ichika...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's taking big steps on her own now.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (All I can do is sing for her...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But if that's my way of helping, then I want to keep doing what I can for her and the girls.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That was wonderful, Ichika.
Your hard work's really paid off.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm sure you'll be able to touch everyone's hearts with this song.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It always feels like you end up giving me the most amount of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Also, Miku...
I asked you to come here today because there's something I'd like to tell you...
Hm? Ichika...?
